Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE small game UI map waypoint marker, isolated transparent PNG.
Reference image is the approved game's Hazel portrait; match aged gold, fine hand-painted angular brushwork and natural material detailing.
A perfectly ROUND circular MEDALLION viewed straight-on, just a thin finely crafted aged-gold rim with two tiny embossed oak leaves at upper left and lower right, and a completely quiet opaque deep teal green central stone face (#142f29). Centered, diameter 72% of square canvas, generous genuine transparent alpha margin outside. The rim should be 12% of diameter, center 76% for legible programmatically drawn station numbers. Understated intricate gold craftsmanship at the rim, clean round silhouette, no protruding branches. No numbers, no letters, no symbols in the center, no character, no object scene, no pedestal, no text, no glow, no floor or cast shadow; not a coin (no currency emblem). This is a reusable waypoint frame seen at 36-48 pixels on a fantasy strategy map, not a full UI.
